description: Held-out synthetic KB retrieval set (40 queries). Do not use this set to tune retrieval parameters; use dataset.json as the development set. Queries and judgments are curated from ATT&CK concepts and the action catalog, but have not been independently validated by SOC analysts.

alert.alert_title: Unusual WMI process creation on a workstation
alert.alert_description: A remote management process used Windows Management Instrumentation to start an unsigned command interpreter on a second endpoint.

queries.query: A program invoked low-level operating-system functions directly instead of using the normal high-level API wrappers.

alert.alert_description: The signed Windows utility regsvr32.exe contacted an external server and registered a scriptlet from a remote URL.

queries.query: An operator created a temporary Windows service on a remote host, started it to run a payload, then removed the service.

alert.alert_description: A compromised account opened a WinRM session from one internal Windows server to another and executed commands remotely.

queries.query: Configuration files on a shared workstation contained clear-text service passwords that were read by an unauthorized process.

alert.alert_description: A file's creation and modification timestamps were changed to make the executable appear older than its actual deployment.

queries.query: A binary with a filename and icon resembling a legitimate operating-system component was launched from a user-writable directory.

alert.alert_title: Periodic DNS requests from an unknown process
alert.alert_description: A workstation repeatedly queried unusual DNS record names and received encoded responses from an external resolver.

queries.query: A developer token was used to upload proprietary source files from a compromised endpoint into an attacker-controlled code-hosting repository.

alert.alert_description: A debugger setting was changed so an unexpected program started when a Windows accessibility feature was invoked at the logon screen.

queries.query: Endpoint telemetry suggests a hidden kernel component is intercepting system activity and concealing its files and processes.

alert.alert_description: An attacker created a hidden directory under a shared profile and placed executable files there to reduce visibility during routine inspection.

queries.query: A Linux binary's permission bits were altered to grant an unprivileged user elevated execution through its owner identity.

alert.alert_description: A process installed a low-level keyboard hook and wrote captured keystrokes to a file outside the user's profile.

queries.query: An untrusted process accessed the local browser profile and extracted saved login credentials and authentication data.

alert.alert_title: Document reader crashed before spawning a payload
alert.alert_description: A crafted document triggered a vulnerability in a client application, followed by execution of an unexpected child process.

queries.query: Internet-facing application logs show a crafted request exploiting a server-side flaw, followed by an unauthorized shell on the web server.

alert.alert_title: Mailbox contents accessed through a remote service
alert.alert_description: An account used an email protocol from an unusual location to retrieve messages from multiple folders without the user's normal mail client.

queries.query: A process accessed the workstation microphone and saved recordings while the user was not participating in a call.

alert.alert_title: Browser session token copied from profile storage
alert.alert_description: A non-browser process read authentication cookie data that could allow the user to be impersonated without entering a password.

queries.query: CPU and GPU utilization remained high overnight because an unauthorized workload was mining cryptocurrency on the server.

alert.alert_description: A compromised workstation began forwarding connections through a local proxy service to reach systems on a restricted network segment.

queries.query: A .vbs file launched by the user ran a sequence of commands through the Windows Visual Basic scripting host.

alert.alert_title: Host firewall rules changed during an intrusion
alert.alert_description: A privileged process disabled host firewall protections and removed rules that blocked inbound remote administration.

queries.query: Track outbound connections made by each process on the affected laptop to identify which executable is contacting an unknown server.

alert.alert_description: Increase network logging and create alerts for abnormal uploads from the affected workstation while the investigation continues.

queries.query: Remove the confirmed malicious executable from the endpoint after preserving the evidence required by the incident response team.

alert.alert_title: Possible malware persistence after initial cleanup
alert.alert_description: Start an on-demand endpoint protection scan on the affected host to search for additional malicious files.

queries.query: Temporarily collect more process, authentication, and network events from this endpoint so the investigation has better visibility.

alert.alert_title: Confirmed malware beacon from a managed laptop
alert.alert_description: The endpoint is actively communicating with a confirmed command server; stop host connectivity and prevent further resolution of the malicious domain.

queries.query: Disable the confirmed rogue autorun entry and scheduled task that relaunch the payload after reboot.

alert.alert_title: Suspicious connection to an external command server
alert.alert_description: Block network traffic to the confirmed destination and retain enhanced logs for unusual flows from the affected segment.

queries.query: The evidence is inconclusive and the alert could affect a critical service; send it to a human analyst before taking an automated action.

alert.alert_description: Acquire a full memory image from the compromised workstation before restarting it or removing the running implant.

queries.query: A privileged account's credentials were stolen and its tokens are still active; invalidate current sessions and require new credentials.

alert.alert_description: Prevent the file from opening again and block its verified hash across managed endpoints.

queries.query: Enable TLS inspection for the affected server group to investigate suspected command traffic hidden inside encrypted sessions.

alert.alert_description: The activity matches the registered internal compliance scanner, is authorized for this maintenance window, and has no indicators of compromise.

queries.query: Immediately disable the confirmed compromised employee account in the identity provider to prevent further sign-ins.
